result.summary: The page is mostly readable, but the bottom navigation area looks visually broken/clipped, with additional minor truncation issues in horizontally scrolling content.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar appears too low and partially overlapped by the system gesture/navigation area; the center search and cart icons look clipped or crowded by the black horizontal bar.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom safe-area padding and ensure the tab bar sits above the system gesture inset so all icons are fully visible and tappable.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip after “Healthy” is cut off at the screen edge without enough visual affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade/arrow or reduce chip spacing so horizontal scrolling is clearer and the next item is visibly peeking.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated in the Fastest near you carousel.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce card content width constraints, or use a smaller font to avoid awkward truncation.
